mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume_file (owner_id, purpose, original_name, storage_path, content_type, file_size) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{purpose}, #{originalName}, #{storagePath}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, purpose, original_name, storage_path, content_type, file_size, created_at, updated_at FROM resume_file WHERE id = #{id}
